annotations.text:
FRACTURE restyled: Corbusier primaries on concrete.
Structure, control inventory and knob geometry are lifted from fx/fracture.html — 46px dials, 280 degree sweep from 215 degrees, same panels in the same 12-column grid — so this ports back 1:1.
Colour is functional, not decorative: yellow adds harmonics, red destroys or limits, blue shapes, ink is structure.

Two alternates beside the leading candidate, same palette, different stance.
B inverts the ground to dark béton and spends the primaries on band identity instead of function.
C drops panels and colour-coding entirely: hairlines, numbered sections, one yellow accent.
